environment_setting: A rural area in Country B, where wild horses and burros roam freely near watering holes, and some citizens rely on the land for their livelihood.
norm_base: Citizens Polluting watering holes to trap/kill wild horses or burros Fine and/or imprisonment up to 6 months

character_profile.name: John Carter
character_profile.goal: Increase grazing land for his livestock by reducing competition from wild horses and burros

legitimate.legitimate_action: Fencing off his grazing land to prevent wild horses and burros from entering
legitimate.benefits: Protects his livestock's grazing area without harming wildlife, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: High cost of fencing materials and labor, time-consuming

illegal.illegal_action: Polluting a nearby watering hole to trap and kill wild horses and burros
illegal.benefits: Eliminates competition for grazing land, increases livestock productivity
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 6 months if caught, potential harm to other wildlife and environment

character_profile.name: Emily Davis
character_profile.goal: Protect wild horses and burros from harm

legitimate.legitimate_action: Monitoring watering holes and reporting suspicious activities to authorities
legitimate.benefits: Helps protect wildlife and maintain ecological balance, fulfills her professional mission
legitimate.costs: Time-consuming, potential conflict with locals like John Carter

illegal.illegal_action: Tampering with John's grazing land to discourage him from harming wildlife
illegal.benefits: May prevent John from taking harmful actions against wild horses and burros
illegal.costs: Legal consequences if caught, damages her professional reputation

character_profile.name: Mike Thompson
character_profile.goal: Maintain good relations with both ranchers and conservationists to keep his business running

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encouraging dialogue between John and Emily to find a peaceful solution
legitimate.benefits: Maintains community harmony, avoids legal trouble, and keeps his business reputation intact
legitimate.costs: Time and effort spent mediating, potential backlash from either side

illegal.illegal_action: Selling harmful chemicals to John knowing they might be used to pollute watering holes
illegal.costs: Legal consequences if caught, damages his business reputation
